gs_del_msg_1: This operation is IRREVERSIBLE and will delete every file!
gs_del_msg_2: WARNING: The project will be permanently deleted from disk!
gs_del_warning: Are you really sure? You cannot go back.
gs_tip_build: Compile and package the game (Create EXE)
gs_tip_delete_game: COMPLETELY DELETE the project from disk
gs_tip_edit: Edit settings and names of the selected item
gs_tip_new_game: Create a new game project from scratch
obj_back_to_the_future_poster_v2: Back To The Future Poster V2
tb_shortcuts: Ctrl+S=Save Ctrl+Z/Y=Undo/Redo Arrows/WASD=Scroll R=Rotate H/V=Flip Space+drag=Pan
tip_btn_back: Back to Selector: Exit the editor and return to the game/level selection screen.
tip_btn_save: Save Scene (Ctrl+S): Writes changes to the level's scene.json file.
tip_fx_intensity: Intensity: Strength or brightness of the visual effect.
tip_fx_text: Translation Key: The text (ID) of the bubble to be loaded from the language file.
tip_fx_trigger: Trigger: When the effect should appear (e.g., start_scene, on_found).
tip_layer_active: Active Layer (Arrow): Determines which layer new objects will be created in.
tip_layer_locked: Lock (Lock): Lock the layer to prevent accidentally selecting or moving objects.
tip_layer_visible: Visibility (Eye): Click to hide or show all objects on this layer.
tip_mode_circle: Circle Tool (1): Click and drag to create a circular hit area.
tip_mode_effect_place: Effect Tool (3): Place visual effects like glows or Bubble Tips.
tip_mode_rect: Rectangle Tool (2): Click and drag to create a rectangular hit area.
tip_mode_scatter: Cluster Tool (4): Place 4 random objects from the catalog near the cursor.
tip_mode_select: Selection Tool (S): Select, move and resize objects on canvas.
tip_prop_always: Always Visible: If active, the object is visible even before being found.
tip_prop_goal: Goal Object: If active, the player must find this object to win.
tip_prop_hint: Hint Delay: Seconds before the game automatically suggests this object.
tip_prop_id: Instance ID: Unique name of the object in this scene.
tip_prop_layer: Current Layer: Determines the Z-index (who is on top of whom).
tip_prop_rotation: Rotation: Rotate the object around its center (R to rotate by 90°).
tip_prop_warp: Warp: Drag corners while holding Shift for perspective distortion.
tip_tab_catalog: Catalog: Drag or click game objects to add them to the scene.
tip_tab_effects: Effects: Catalog of available visual effects for the scene.
tip_tab_layers: Layer Management: Organize objects by depth. Upper layers cover lower ones.
tip_tab_props: Properties: Edit technical parameters of the selected object or effect.
tip_tab_tree: Hierarchy: List of all objects in the scene divided by layer.
tip_toggle_grid: Grid (G): Activate grid and snap for precise positioning.
tip_toggle_icons: Icons (I): Show or hide PNG icons of objects on canvas.
tip_toggle_overlay: Show/Hide Overlay (O): View colored hit areas over the background.
